title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster Busts Loose! - Towards Orbit
description:
This BG is seen where Buster jumps from the train to the ground, running towards a ramp and jumps from the ramp really high, launching him into orbit. Use Horizontal and Vertical scrolling either to variable or constant for a transition.
Uses the first half of palette 1. Do not change the back area color, as it is used below.

Have fun using it!
